name: interactive-web-studio
description: Premium, cinematic, highly interactive sites — immersive motion, WebGL/Three.js, custom shaders, smooth scroll, scroll-driven storytelling. Best for expressive/experimental directions.

name: capcut-design
description: Clean, modern product UI with an exact token system (color, type, spacing). Best for polished, consistent, restrained directions.

name: webgl-trail-reveal
description: A mouse-trail image-reveal mechanic (calm ↔ dramatic). Best when the site has a strong hero image or a before/after story.

name: exploded-showcase
description: Cinematic 3D product teardown / exploded hero with labeled parts. Best when the site sells a physical product, device or machine.

name: scroll-craft
description: Premium scroll-driven landing pages — layered depth heroes, scroll-as-timeline storytelling, one engineered peak, separate mobile art direction. Best for service, product, food and drink brands.
